brief: Registers the facets a cluster knows: logical competences such as graph or nlp, with their capabilities and the modules that realize them.
detail: A facet is a competence a cluster routes along, not a physical module. A fresh catalog holds the 18 standard facets; Define and DefinePolyglot add or override one and Drop removes one. The catalog belongs to its instance, so two clusters in one process can have different facets. MappingKindOf says whether a facet is grounded in one module, composed from several, external (served by a tool such as python) or purely logical.
